preconditions.description: The number of rows in the tables A and B is at least 1.
The number of columns in the tables A and B is at least 1.
The elements of the tables A and B are within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (0 <= k <= 5000 and all(1 <= c_i <= m for c_i in sequence))
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if it is not possible to transform A into B, otherwise it is a non-negative integer k followed by k integers c_i, where each c_i is a column index within the range of 1 to m.

invariants.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in A) and all(len(row) == m for row in B)
invariants.description: Both tables A and B have the same number of columns m.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= row[i] <= n for row in A for i in range(m)) and all(1 <= row[i] <= n for row in B for i in range(m))
invariants.description: All elements in tables A and B are within the range of 1 to n.
